title: HumanReviewFlag
description: Three-state enum for human review attestation. Co-field requirements vary by state. v0.1-DRAFT. See NOTICE.md: this service does not verify reviewer identity or review completeness.

state.description: none: no human review claimed. attested: a human attested to reviewing this entry; co-fields required. sampled: entry selected by an automated sampling policy; co-fields required.

attested_by.description: Opaque identity token for the attesting party. This service does not resolve this token to a real person or verify identity. Required when state=attested.

attestation_timestamp_utc.description: RFC 3339. Must be >= parent entry timestamp_utc and <= ingest receipt time + 72 hours. Required when state=attested.

attestation_justification.description: Free-text explanation of the attestation. Minimum 200 characters. Required when state=attested.

attestation_scope.description: full: entire entry reviewed. partial: partial review; partial_scope_note required. Required when state=attested.

partial_scope_note.description: Required when state=attested AND attestation_scope=partial. Minimum 50 characters describing what was and was not reviewed.

sample_rate.description: Fraction of entries selected by this sampling policy, expressed as a decimal (e.g. 0.05 = 5%). Required when state=sampled.

sample_method.description: Description of the sampling algorithm or policy. Minimum 20 characters. Required when state=sampled.

sampled_by_system.description: Identifier of the automated system that selected this entry for sampling. Required when state=sampled.
